safety_and_limits: No EXE execution, hardware I/O, network scanning, unknown writes or private uploads.
No address-gap inference. Explicit continuation is channel-stride only, bounded by actual negotiated chain.
Up to16 expansion modules; channel capacity per unlisted expansion remains unknown.
Host firmwareV1.1 incompatible with listed newer expansion modules; V1.2 described compatible (§6 p57).
Register table default states are not independently proven boot/persistence behavior.
Network setting modifications require save/restart in UI (§5.2 p55); save/restart wire commands not documented.
None of these claims has been verified against live firmware.
